items.title: Controllore di un bus aggredito dagli studenti, la testa spinta sull'asfalto
items.summary: Accerchiato e colpito da minorenni nel Vicentino. L'azienda: 'Episodio inqualificabile'
items.content:
Prima provocano i passeggeri e il personale del bus, premendo più volte l'allarme, poi in branco assalgono e picchiano selvaggiamente il controllore, che li aveva redarguiti. Il tutto circondati da altri coetanei a fare il "tifo" per la bravata violenta. L'episodio è avvenuto nella mattinata di ieri intorno alle ore 7.35, prima dell'inizio delle lezioni, alla Cittadella degli Studi, quartiere scolastico di Vicenza.

Vittima un dipendente della società del trasporto locale Svt, che è stato accerchiato da una quindicina di studenti e colpito. Secondo le testimonianze, gli aggressori avrebbero un'età tra i 15 e i 17 anni e frequenterebbero un istituto a Schio (Vicenza).

Durante il tragitto uno di loro avrebbe azionato con insistenza l'allarme del mezzo. Il controllore lo ha richiamato all'ordine, poi, durante la sosta davanti alle scuole, passeggeri e addetti sono scesi dall'autobus. A quel punto, uno o più probabilmente due giovani avrebbero aggredito il controllore; un ragazzo gli avrebbe spinto la testa contro l'asfalto; altri studenti avrebbero incitato i violenti. Nonostante i colpi subiti, l'operatore non avrebbe reagito e si sarebbe rialzato tornando a bordo del bus, anche se ovviamente era sotto choc. Il branco si è allontanato.

Un'altra aggressione era avvenuta la settimana scorsa, alla stessa fermata, sempre contro il personale di Svt che era stato fatto oggetto di insulti ma non di aggressioni fisiche. "Un episodio inqualificabile - ha commentato il presidente, Marco Sandonà - che mi auguro possa trovare la condanna ferma e unanime da parte di tutti. Non si è trattato di una bravata, ma di un'aggressione vera e propria. Il richiamo al rispetto delle regole di viaggio, e nel caso specifico all'utilizzo appropriato dei dispositivi di emergenza, è un elemento basilare per il funzionamento stesso del trasporto pubblico locale".

Sandonà preannuncia il sostegno aziendale al dipendente vittima dell'aggressione "a tutela sua, ma anche dell'azienda e di tutto il personale. In questi casi è importante evitare ogni forma di strumentalizzazione, ma penso sia condivisibile che questo episodio si innesta in un clima di crescenti tensioni nei confronti del trasporto pubblico locale, forse esacerbato anche da ciò che stiamo vedendo accadere in Italia e in Europa".

Il sindacato Filt Cgil afferma che "quanto accaduto non può essere liquidato come una 'ragazzata' o una 'bravata'. Un lavoratore è stato accerchiato, colpito e scaraventato a terra semplicemente perché stava svolgendo il proprio lavoro". Auspica inoltre che "siano individuati rapidamente i responsabili di questa aggressione e che vengano adottati tutti i provvedimenti necessari nei loro confronti. Chiediamo infine a Svt, alle istituzioni locali, al mondo della scuola di aprire immediatamente un confronto sulla sicurezza del personale viaggiante e dei verificatori, e di garantire la tutela legale al lavoratore e di aggiornare il Documento di Valutazione dei Rischi per il riconoscimento dell'infortunio".

items.title: Ranucci sceglie Rainews, delega per gli approfondimenti ma nessuna conduzione
items.summary: Foto di gruppo di Report senza Mottola, che smentisce un suo addio alla trasmissione
items.content:
"Torno da dove sono partito con la certezza di aver fatto tutto ciò che dovevo e di aver contribuito per 20 lunghi anni al successo di una trasmissione come Report, che è il fiore all'occhiello della televisione pubblica. Torno con il sorriso, che nessuna ingiustizia riuscirà a togliermi". Sigfrido Ranucci annuncia così su Facebook la sua scelta tra le tre opzioni che la Rai gli aveva proposto dopo la rimozione dalla conduzione di Report.

Niente Tg3 e niente sede del Cairo, dunque, la preferenza è ricaduta su Rainews, dove il giornalista aveva lavorato dal 1999 al 2006. Ranucci si è preso tutto il tempo necessario, fino alla tarda serata di ieri, quando scadeva il termine dopo la proroga concessa dall'azienda, per comunicare la sua decisione.

Fino all'ultimo momento si è confrontato con i suoi avvocati, anche perché la battaglia legale, nonostante il ricorso d'urgenza contro il suo spostamento sia stato respinto, è tutt'altro che conclusa.

Intanto il Tribunale di Roma si dovrà pronunciare sul merito, anche se serviranno mesi, e non è escluso che in quella sede possano emergere valutazioni diverse rispetto a quelle sposate dalla giudice Donatella Casari, secondo cui la rimozione sarebbe stata decisa per risolvere le tensioni interne scaturite dal clamore mediatico intorno all'inchiesta sull'attentato. A breve, forse già questa settimana, verrà, inoltre, presentato il ricorso contro la sospensione di dieci giorni comminatagli dalla Rai a seguito del parere del Comitato etico che ha ritenuto la sua condotta in contrasto con le regole aziendali.

"Sono stato accolto con molto affetto dalla redazione di Rainews - racconta Ranucci -, dove ci sono molti vecchi amici con cui abbiamo realizzato inchieste memorabili negli anni in cui c'era Berlusconi al governo".

L'ex conduttore di Report avrà una delega sugli approfondimenti, in sostanza dovrà occuparsi delle quattro rubriche che realizza la redazione all-news, ma le risorse sono limitate e a condurle sono gli stessi autori delle inchieste. Ranucci, che mantiene la carica di vicedirettore ad personam, non dovrebbe andare in video secondo le nuove regole di ingaggio. Il giornalista dovrà comunque scontare i dieci giorni di sospensione, che sono la pena massima prima del licenziamento, ma la data di avvio della sanzione non gli è stata ancora comunicata.

L'ex conduttore di Report, che ha 65 anni, ha, inoltre, quasi 300 giorni di ferie e recuperi da smaltire e dovrà farlo un po' alla volta, se non vuole di fatto assentarsi per un lunghissimo periodo dal lavoro.

Intanto l'8 novembre potrà essere tra gli spettatori del debutto della nuova stagione di Report, condotto da Claudia Di Pasquale e Daniele Piervincenzi. La squadra si è voluta mostrare al completo in una foto di gruppo postata sui profili social del programma, nella quale c'è chi ha notato l'assenza di Giorgio Mottola, uno dei volti di punta del programma, che però smentisce le voci di rottura con la trasmissione.

Al gruppo è arrivato domenica da 'Che tempo che fa' il sostegno di Milena Gabanelli. "Penso che nessuno faccia niente da solo - ha detto l'ex conduttrice -. Puoi diventare il volto del programma, ma la forza è la squadra, che si è rimpolpata di colleghi più giovani, ma molti sono quelli che ho lasciato dieci anni fa. Sono convinta che si possa sopravvivere alla sparizione dei capi". C'è attesa per capire se le nuove inchieste saranno in linea con le precedenti e se gli ascolti risentiranno dell'uscita di Ranucci. Sono molti, infatti, gli utenti che, commentando i nuovi spot della trasmissione, accusano di tradimento i suoi ex compagni di squadra e annunciano che non guarderanno più il programma.

"Dopo la rimozione da Report, la Rai mi ha posto davanti a una scelta: la sede del Cairo in qualità di corrispondente, il Tg3 a disposizione del direttore, oppure RaiNews24 con delega agli approfondimenti. Ringrazio il direttore Luca Terzulli e i colleghi del Tg3 per avermi aperto, in un momento così complicato della mia vita professionale, le porte di quella testata dove trentasei anni fa ho mosso i primi passi: prima come assistente ai programmi, poi come giornalista. Dopo giorni tormentati ho scelto di tornare a RaiNews, il porto da cui ero salpato prima di approdare a Report". Lo spiega Sigfrido Ranucci su Facebook.

"Milena Gabanelli mi chiamò dopo aver realizzato l'inchiesta che denunciò l'uso di armi chimiche da parte degli Stati Uniti, il fosforo bianco, a Falluja: un lavoro realizzato tra il 2004 e il 2005 che, per la prima volta nella sua storia, portò il nome della Rai nel mondo con uno scoop internazionale - ricorda il giornalista -. Armi tremende che ancora oggi, nel silenzio degli indecenti, vengono usate da Israele a Gaza e in Libano. All'epoca il mio direttore era Roberto Morrione, il mio maestro. Insieme realizzammo molte inchieste: sull'uso dei proiettili all'uranio impoverito, sulla vera natura della missione militare a Nassiriya e, soprattutto, quella che nel 2000 portò al ritrovamento dell'intervista perduta al giudice Paolo Borsellino. In quell'intervista, realizzata appena due giorni prima della strage di Capaci, il magistrato parlò per la prima volta dei rapporti tra la mafia e i fratelli Dell'Utri, e della figura di Vittorio Mangano, lo stalliere di Arcore".

"Oggi il direttore è Federico Zurzolo, che ringrazio per la fiducia - prosegue l'ex conduttore di Report -. Ritroverò tanti vecchi compagni di quella Rainews appena nata che alla fine degli anni 90, come una nave corsara, solcava il mare in tempesta dell'informazione. Torno da dove sono partito con la certezza di aver fatto tutto ciò che dovevo e di aver contribuito per 20 lunghi anni al successo di una trasmissione come Report, che è il fiore all'occhiello della televisione pubblica e del giornalismo d'inchiesta nazionale e internazionale. Torno con il sorriso, che nessuna ingiustizia riuscirà a togliermi. E con la voglia intatta di combattere ancora le battaglie importanti per il nostro Paese. Quella per la libertà di informazione: in difesa dei diritti, accanto ai più fragili e a chi, in questo Paese, non ha voce".

items.title: Modella fan di Bolsonaro diventa virale, ma è creata dall'IA
items.summary: Julia è giovane, bionda e ha mezzo milione di followers. Ma non esiste
items.content:
Nella campagna brasiliana la destra si inventa i testimonial. Da settimane il candidato trumpiano Flavio Bolsonaro appare in video ormai virali mentre balla con una modella molto bella, una sorta di influencer, Julia Berlli Cortez, con ben 500mila follower. Ma nelle ultime ore si è scoperto che questa ragazza, che secondo la sua biografia su Istragram ha 22 anni, e studia medicina, semplicemente non esiste. E' un prodotto dell'intelligenza artificiale.

Un vero e proprio testimonial creato in laboratorio, visto che questa ragazza è stata intervistata e i suoi interventi sono diventati popolarissimi in rete. Per renderla più credibile, oltre a postare decine di selfie allo specchio, ha postato anche storie sui suoi social di suoi presunti fidanzati, come avrebbe fatto qualsiasi ragazza della sua età. Ma tutto è assolutamente falso.

Peccato per Bolsonaro e il suo staff che alcuni debunker, persone specializzate a trovare i profili fake, l'hanno scoperta. I falsari hanno fatto alcuni errori: nei video mentre partecipa alle manifestazioni politiche ha sempre lo stesso vestito, e spesso è scalza. Particolari che hanno fatto scattare i sospetti e che alla fine hanno portato a scoprire la verità.

In un'intervista, lei spiega sorridente perchè è di destra. Peccato che quella intervista e quelle parole non erano le sue, ma esattamente quelle pronunciate da una militante, sempre bolsonarista, ma decisamente molto meno attraente. Insomma, la strategia è semplice ed efficace: grazie alla creazione di un profilo finto, di una bella ragazza, si produce la confezione perfetta per attirare contatti e followers in modo da veicolare meglio i propri contenuti.

Infine, particolare piccante che rende la storia ancora più triste: i creatori di questo profilo non si sono limitati a lavorare nel settore della propaganda politica, ma hanno anche cercato di ottenere un po' di soldi su un altro fronte: cliccando sul canale telegram di questa ragazza e pagando 30-40 reales, meno di dieci euro, è possibile vedere suoi contenuti porno, ovviamente anche questi completamente falsi.

items.title: Alla Scala salta la prima del Faust per lo sciopero dei lavoratori
items.summary: Comunicato del teatro, 'non ci sono le condizioni per la rappresentazione'
items.content:
"A causa dello sciopero indetto dai lavoratori del Teatro, non ci sono le condizioni per la rappresentazione dell'opera Faust di Charles Gounod , prevista per questa sera"; lo comunica in una nota La Fondazione Teatro alla Scala. La prossima rappresentazione di Faust è prevista per sabato 24 ottobre alle 19.30. I biglietti per lo spettacolo verranno rimborsati.

È altissima l'adesione allo sciopero indetto alla Scala da Cgil, Cisl, Uil e Fials per il rinnovo del contratto . Questa mattina i lavoratori hanno organizzato un presidio accanto all'ingresso del teatro dove hanno inscenato dei passi di danza mentre musicisti e coristi hanno eseguiti alcuni brani fra cui il 'Va', pensiero', 'Bella, ciao', 'Libertango' e 'Fischia il vento'. Il teatro aspetta solo l'inizio dell'ultimo turno per annunciare che la rappresentazione del Faust in programma questa sera, la prima dell'opera di Gounod, sarà cancellata. Ed è probabile che altrettanto avvenga con le prossime prime: quella della Messa da Reqiuem diretta da Riccardo Chailly il 28 ottobre e quella del balletto 'Balanchine, Bausch Stravinskij' del 7 novembre. I sindacati ribadiscono la loro richiesta: un aumento del 15% della retribuzione annua lorda per recuperare l'inflazione, con ulteriori adeguamenti alla previsione dell'inflazione graduali negli anni. Si tratta di una richiesta però che, secondo le stime del teatro, richiederebbe 37 milioni di euro in tre anni, troppo per le casse del teatro.

items.title: Artemis II, lo scudo termico di Orion supera l'esame della NASA
items.summary: La NASA mostra lo scudo termico di Orion dopo Artemis II e conferma i risultati delle analisi.
items.content:
Quando si affronta una missione nello spazio, che prevede un ritorno, il rientro sulla Terra è uno dei momenti più delicati di qualsiasi. Questo perché in pochi minuti, nella delicata fase dell'ingresso nell'atmosfera terrestre, il veicolo deve sopportare temperature estreme senza mettere in pericolo gli astronauti. A fare la differenza è soprattutto lo scudo termico, una barriera progettata per assorbire e dissipare il calore generato dall'attrito e dalla compressione dell'aria.

La NASA ha pubblicato una spettacolare immagine subacquea dello scudo termico della capsula Orion, fotografato dai sommozzatori della Marina statunitense subito dopo l'ammaraggio di Artemis II, avvenuto il 10 aprile 2026 nell'Oceano Pacifico.

La fotografia mostra la superficie dello scudo, apparentemente azzurra per effetto dell'acqua, e rappresenta una delle prime testimonianze visive delle condizioni della capsula dopo il viaggio lunare.

items.title: L'interfaccia di Windows 11 ha ancora problemi di coerenza, e Microsoft lo sa
items.summary: Una grossa mano la stanno dando anche gli agenti AI. E il loro contributo è destinato solo ad aumentare.
items.content:
Microsoft usa sempre di più l'AI per supportare il lavoro dei designer e degli sviluppatori di Windows 11, per tutta una serie di iniziative, inclusa quella che punta a risolvere una delle critiche più frequenti degli utenti: la mancanza di coerenza nell'interfaccia del sistema operativo. Ne ha parlato nelle scorse ore su Twitter Diego Baca, vicepresidente del Product Design dell'azienda, che ha riconosciuto apertamente le aspettative ancora insoddisfatte della community. L'occasione per parlarne è stata una richiesta diretta di un fan piuttosto "lungimirante", diciamo così.

La domanda era pressappoco quanto fosse fattibile distribuire un'intera squadra di agenti AI nel workflow degli sviluppatori di Microsoft, e incaricarli di individuare e risolvere i problemi di Windows, non solo a livello di interfaccia ma più in generale. Baca ha spiegato che l'intelligenza artificiale viene già utilizzata per aiutare i designer nel loro lavoro, anche se il punto principale della sua risposta verteva soprattutto sulla necessità di rendere l'esperienza d'uso di Windows 11 più uniforme.

I honestly hope this kills the Start Menu. That sucker's dated and I do everything I can to avoid it when I'm forced.

items.title: Suspect arrested after historic town hall set alight - French media
items.summary: The spire of the clock tower at Limoges city hall dramatically collapsed as it was engulfed in flames on Saturday.
items.content:
A suspect linked to a far-left movement has been arrested in France after a 19th Century city hall was gutted by a fire over the weekend that broke out during mass disorder, French media report.

The clock tower and parts of the roof of the ornate city hall in the central city of Limoges were engulfed in flames before collapsing on Saturday.

The 34-year-old suspect is known to police for acts of violence against public officials and is on a French national security watchlist, FranceInfo and BFM TV report.

French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has vowed a "massive" police presence during further protests planned for Saturday, while young people in Marseille will be subject to curfews for most of this week.

The city's mayor Benoît Payan said on X that the prefect had decided to introduce the curfew "starting this evening and for days to come", with French media reporting it would be in place overnight from Tuesday to Friday.

Payan said the measures apply to minors and will only be in commercial areas of the city, which were particularly affected by looting which took place last weekend.

Paris's police commissioner has also ordered the extension of an overnight curfew in the capital. The Préfecture de Police said the measure would continue "for as long as it proves necessary".

A curfew for parts of central Lyon, in France's south-east, has also been renewed.

French Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin told BFM Television that 149 people were in detention following widespread demonstrations over the weekend.

Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators took to the streets to protest against rising fuel prices, the cost of living and deteriorating public services, including schools.

Darmanin previously said he asked prosecutors to be "extremely firm" and "ruthless towards those who attacked police officers, gendarmes and firefighters, who looted shops and who attacked public buildings".

Lecornu told French parliament on Tuesday afternoon a large number of police would meet demonstrators at a planned protest on Saturday.

Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez previously admitted police had "lost control" in some cities over the weekend.

He was strongly criticised by opposition politicians over authorities' preparedness for the disorder, leading him to offer his resignation on Monday, which was rejected by President Emmanuel Macron.

Lecornu also accused far-left groups of an "insurrectionary" plan over the weekend's mass chaos.

Responding to an earlier, similar accusation from Lecornu, left-wing La France Insoumise (LFI) de facto leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon had called for the prime minister to "prove his accusation" or "apologise, shut up, and stop stoking disorder".

On Tuesday, Mélenchon urged followers on social media to show "restraint" in the face of any "provocation".

Lecornu earlier said targeted curfews introduced across France on Monday contributed to a quiet night following the disorder.

Curfews were introduced across parts of central Paris, including Place de la République, where protesters had gathered over the weekend, and the Les Halles shopping area.

Other measures restricting the movement of young people and gatherings were introduced on Monday in cities such as Marseille, Bordeaux, Nice and Lyon in the south, as well as Lille and other towns in the north.

A crowd assembled in Lyon on Monday night in support of businesses affected by the disorder but dispersed without violating the curfew, officials said.

The Rhône prefecture said on social media that it was "furious" that a far-right group tried to hijack the gathering. The prefecture said on X it reported the group to the public prosecutor for alleged Islamophobic and xenophobic remarks.

Lecornu thanked police officers and gendarmes for enforcing the measures, adding that further curfews on Tuesday night would be decided depending on where they were necessary.

Writing in a post on X, he said decisions would be made "on the ground" by French regions and local mayors.

More than 2,500 people have been arrested since the disorder broke out, officials said on Monday. One demonstrator's hand was blown off by a police crowd-control grenade, according to the AFP news agency. About 1,000 police officers were injured.

Protests first began last month with students demanding better school conditions but they have escalated to take in a broader range of concerns with numbers at demonstrations bolstered by trade unions and various protest groups.

More than 2,000 shops and other businesses have been directly impacted by the weekend's violence, the head of France's Chambers of Commerce and Industry (CCI) said.

Rioters, some dressed in black and wearing masks and balaclavas, were seen setting fire to cars and buildings and looting businesses in Paris, Marseille and other cities and smaller towns.

Protest organisers earlier declared that a second round of protests will take place on Saturday across France.

The so-called yellow vests (gilets jaunes), who were responsible for France's longest-ever modern protests in 2018, has said "Act II" will take place this weekend.

Meanwhile, French union La CGT has called for a major day of strikes on 5 November.

items.title: Spotify, da oggi in Italia le novità per i video podcast: cosa cambia per creator e utenti
items.summary: Al debutto anche le Memberships.
items.content:
Spotify ha annunciato la disponibilità in Italia di Partner Program, che da oggi consente agli utenti Premium di fruire dei video podcast idonei senza annunci dinamici. Con questa novità, i creator guadagneranno in base alle visualizzazioni dei video, mentre le pubblicità dinamiche continueranno a monetizzare gli episodi sulla versione free di Spotify e sulle altre piattaforme in distribuzione.

  • nessun annuncio pubblicitario dinamico per i clienti Premium nei video podcast idonei. La monetizzazione per i creator avviene sulla base delle visualizzazioni
  • annunci pubblicitari dinamici per gli utenti free e per coloro che riproducono podcast audio su Spotify o altre piattaforme. La monetizzazione per i creator avviene sulla base degli annunci visualizzati

Aderendo a Spotify Partner Program, i creator ricevono il 50% dei ricavi riconosciuti per ogni annuncio riprodotto nei propri episodi sia su Spotify che sulle altre piattaforme, in più hanno la facoltà di scegliere i punti in cui inserire le interruzioni pubblicitarie. In sintesi:

  • creator:
    • nessun annuncio pubblicitario dinamico: ricavi diretti basati sulle visualizzazioni
    • annunci gestiti da Spotify: metà dei ricavi per ogni annuncio visualizzato
    • sponsorizzazioni nello show: 100% dei ricavi
  • clienti Premium:
    • meno interruzioni pubblicitarie grazie all'eliminazione degli annunci dinamici

MEMBERSHIPS

Memberships è la seconda novità che debutta oggi in Italia: pensata per rafforzare il rapporto con la community, permette ai creator idonei di offrire ai loro fan esperienze esclusive come nuovi episodi audio e video, contenuti bonus e accesso anticipato. Ciò facilita strumenti come pubblicità targettizzate, prove gratuite e analisi sull'andamento delle iscrizioni con accesso a dati esportabili sui partecipanti, generando un flusso di entrate ricorrenti (il 90% dei ricavi resta ai creator).

Voxtral 3 introduces a cutting-edge voice agent SDK and state-of-the-art speech models designed for real-time, multi-step conversations across 50+ languages. It combines accurate transcription, natural speech synthesis with emotional adaptability, and deep tool integration for seamless workflow automation. Available via Mistral’s EU-hosted API or self-deployment, it ensures data sovereignty while delivering low-latency, human-like interactions for contact centers, virtual assistants, and hands-free copilots.

Speech transcription and voice generation have come a long way, but building end-to-end voice agents that can listen, reason, interact, and handle complex workflows remains difficult.

A reliable voice agent needs to do four things very well (and simultaneously):

Listen accurately across languages, accents, speakers, and interruptions,

Getting all four to work together reliably in real time remains a challenge.

To address this, we introduce Voxtral 3: a new family of state-of-the-art speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, alongside a voice agent SDK that brings listening, thinking, tool calling, and speaking into a single real-time streaming pipeline.

Voxtral 3 is built to create natural conversational experiences, from contact-center agents and service desks to virtual assistants and hands-free copilots. With support for dozens of languages, expressive speech, complex reasoning, and deep integration with your own tools and data, agents built with Voxtral can interpret nuanced intent, reason through sophisticated requests, and execute multi-step actions across connected systems.

As with other Mistral models, the Voxtral 3 family is designed for sovereign deployment. Available today through Mistral's EU-hosted API or for self-deployment on your own infrastructure, it gives organizations control over where audio is processed, how data is handled, and whether conversations are retained.

Accurate transcription across 50+ languages . The speech-to-text model, Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 , is state-of-the-art in multilingual transcription, identifying who said what (diarization), using keyphrases to improve its accuracy (context-biasing). It detects when someone has finished speaking so agents can respond without delay (end-of-turn detection).

Natural speech that adapts to the conversation . The text-to-speech model, Voxtral Mini TTS 3 , introduces new voices that adjust their emotion, pace, and emphasis based on conversational context, with support for 35+ languages and 50+ dialects.

Human-like intelligence at your (spoken) command . The new voice agent SDK combines listening, reasoning, tool calling, and speaking into a real-time experience. Agents can retrieve information, interact with business systems, and complete tasks during live conversations over phone or web.

Pro Voice for distinctly accurate voice adaptation . For professional use cases where basic voice cloning does not suffice, Voxtral’s Pro Voice adaptation is able to reproduce a speaker’s distinctive character, emotional range, and speaking style across languages, using just 30 minutes of audio.

Your voice AI, on your infrastructure . Use Mistral's EU-hosted API or deploy Voxtral 3 on your own infrastructure. Keep sensitive conversations within your environment and control whether any audio is retained.

Voxtral Transcribe 3 represents a significant milestone across transcription, diarization (who spoke when) and context biasing capabilities. The supported list of languages is expanded to 50, including 24 official EU languages and many low-resource Asian and Indic languages.

The Small version achieves state-of-the-art results across diarization and multilingual transcription, including in English, French and Spanish. It outperforms Whisper, Scribe v2 and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. The Mini variant is 4B parameters, enabling fast and accurate transcriptions at a price of $0.0035/min.

Both models support context biasing, where key terms and free-form text can be given to bias the transcription and improve recall on technical terms. This enables them to be used in production settings with domain-specific vocabulary without the need for fine-tuning.

Voxtral Realtime Transcribe 3 is a realtime transcription model built for agentic use-cases. It achieves high-quality transcriptions at sub-500ms latency in over 35 languages, including with diarization and context biasing.

End-of-turn prediction is natively supported, incorporating both acoustic and semantic information to accurately predict when a user is finished speaking. This allows for low-latency voice agent applications, while minimizing false cut-off rates when the user is prematurely interrupted.

Voxtral Mini TTS 3.0 , available in batch and realtime, achieves state-of-the-art expressiveness and instruction following for 35+ languages and 50+ dialects. At $13 per 1M characters, Voxtral Speech 3 costs less to run than comparable models from OpenAI TTS-1, Deepgram, ElevenLabs Flash and Gemini Flash.

The speech model implicitly interprets the semantic meaning of context better, producing natural speech across a diverse range of emotions and languages. New and improved features include voice cloning from 30+ minutes of sampled audio, custom prompt instruction following (IF), contextual TTS, and a vocabulary library, all of which serve the goal of speech reliability in deployment. Variables for Explicit IF include emotion , pacing , and emphasis .

items.title: Sixteen Years After Deepwater Horizon, Deep Sea Life Shows Few Signs of Recovery
items.summary: Article URL: https://e360.yale.edu/digest/deepwater-horizon-deep-sea-recovery Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50168357 Points: 71 # Comments: 35
items.content:
Sixteen years after an explosion on the Deepwater Horizon oil rig unleashed more than 4 million barrels of oil into the Gulf of Mexico, life in the deep sea has yet to recover.

A new study finds that in the first few years after the 2010 disaster, populations of octopus, squid, krill, shrimp, and lanternfish declined by at least 60 percent. The research, based on acoustic surveys and thousands of netted samples across a broad swath of the Gulf of Mexico, found little evidence that life in the deep sea has bounced back.

The study, published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences , described the losses as “the fastest and most severe” decline of animal life in the ocean layer that extends from about 600 feet deep to more than two miles down. While researchers stopped short of concluding that the oil spill had caused the declines, they said it was “the most parsimonious explanation.”

Since the disaster, scientists have found oil-related compounds in the flesh of squid and octopus and in fish eggs deep underwater, contamination that they say can impair reproduction and development or lead to an early death. Lingering pollution may make it harder for deep-sea fish that are guided by their sense of smell to find mates.

Beyond the drop in population numbers, the new study also found some declines in genetic diversity. The risk, authors say, is that populations may not harbor the genetic traits needed to survive in a rapidly changing world.

items.title: Swimmer, 65, killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
items.summary: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.
items.content:
A South African woman has been killed in a shark attack off the country's east coast, in what is the first recorded such fatality this year.

Janine Lochrenberg was swimming off a beach in KuGompo City (formerly East London) on Tuesday morning when she was attacked.

Witnesses said the 65-year-old was bitten in two places and died before she was brought to shore.

Shark attacks are rare in South Africa, with about 10 fatal ones since 2012, according to the Florida Museum's International Shark Attack File.

Lochrenberg was out on a daily morning swim with her local open water swimming club when she was attacked at around 08:00 (06:00 GMT). Fellow swimmers brought her to shore, but it's believed she died before they could get her out of the water.

She was bitten on her thigh and her upper arm, one of her fellow swimmers told the BBC. They also said she had been wearing a magnetic shark repellent band on her ankle at the time.

Lochrenberg's sister Margot said she was holding her sister's head as they brought her to shore but believed she bled out in the water.

She told the BBC that her sister had "loved the water so much" despite knowing there was an "elevated shark presence in East London".

"She'd made peace with that. She had a deep affinity with the water and was a remarkable person," she said.

Barbara Briceland, Lochrenberg's partner, told the BBC the retired medical physicist was a good swimmer, who often swam far out into the breakers, and described her as very brave.

"She was highly intelligent, lots of fun, kind, in a quietish way, thoughtful, well-loved with a love of life."

Briceland added they were looking forward to retirement and were about to leave for a three-week road trip together.

Orient Beach, where the attack took place, has been closed alongside another nearby beach, authorities confirmed.

items.title: Garmin Edge 1060 è il nuovo ciclocomputer che si controlla senza togliere le mani dal manubrio
items.summary: Garmin annuncia tre nuovi ciclocomputer della gamma Edge, il top di gamma Edge 1060 e i nuovi Edge Explore 3 ed Edge Explore 3 Plus. Il top di gamma si controlla completamente con la voce, si integra con TrainPeaks e permette anche di ricaricare smartphone e luci ... Leggi tutto
items.content:
Garmin rinnova la propria gamma di ciclocomputer annunciando tre nuovi modelli che introducono come principale novità l'integrazione di microfono e altoparlante sul manubrio.

In cima all'offerta si posiziona il nuovo Garmin Edge 1060 , top di gamma pensato per gli utenti più esigenti e per chi cerca strumenti di analisi avanzati. La caratteristica distintiva del modello è il supporto ai comandi vocali diretti : tramite il comando “OK, Garmin” è possibile richiedere informazioni sulle metriche di corsa, navigare verso punti di interesse o inviare segnalazioni di ostacoli e buche senza mai staccare le mani dal manubrio. Oltre ai comandi, l'hardware audio integrato permette la riproduzione ad alta voce delle indicazioni turn-by-turn e la gestione dei messaggi vocali bidirezionali tramite l'applicazione Garmin Messenger.

Sul fronte dell'interfaccia, Edge 1060 affianca al display touch una serie di tasti fisici pensati per agevolare il controllo con i guanti o sotto la pioggia . Il pacchetto software include funzioni come la gestione della Stamina in tempo reale, le indicazioni di potenza tramite Power Guide, il rilevamento avanzato delle uscite di gruppo GroupRide e l'integrazione con i piani di allenamento di TrainingPeaks (piattaforma che ricordiamo Garmin ha acquisito la scorsa estate). La batteria garantisce fino a 20 ore di autonomia in condizioni di uso intenso, estendibili a 60 in risparmio energetico, e supporta la ricarica inversa tramite porta USB-C per alimentare dispositivi esterni o luci compatibili.

Per chi cerca una soluzione orientata soprattutto alla navigazione e alla cicloturistica arrivano invece i nuovi modelli della serie Explore. Il modello base, Garmin Edge Explore 3 , punta sull'essenzialità e sull'efficienza di calcolo dei percorsi. Offre un display touchscreen e mappe dettagliate che suggeriscono itinerari alternativi in base al tipo di bici o al dislivello, notificando pericoli segnalati dalla community e punti di interesse lungo la traccia tramite la funzione Up Ahead. A livello di allenamento integra il supporto a Garmin Cycling Coach con programmi adattivi per principianti, garantendo la compatibilità con le e-bike per il monitoraggio della carica e un'autonomia dichiarata che raggiunge le 16 ore in uso intenso e 48 ore in risparmio energetico.

L' Edge Explore 3 Plus riprende la medesima impostazione costruttiva e le funzioni cartografiche dell'Explore 3, ma aggiunge il comparto audio con altoparlante e microfono integrati. A differenza dell'Edge 1060 non dispone dei comandi vocali completi per il controllo del dispositivo, ma sfrutta il microfono per consentire l'invio e la ricezione di messaggi vocali via Garmin Messenger. L'altoparlante integrato riproduce le indicazioni stradali e gli aggiornamenti di navigazione, oltre a poter essere utilizzato come campanello digitale per segnalare la propria presenza. A causa del maggior consumo legato alle componenti audio, l'autonomia massima in modalità di uso intenso per la versione Plus scende leggermente a 14 ore, mantenendo comunque le 48 ore in risparmio energetico.

Anche sul versante dei dei dispositivi per ciclisti, prezzi in salita rispetto ai modelli precedenti Garmin, con rincari tra i 100 e i 200 euro: l'Edge 1060 ha un prezzo di 799,99 euro (l’Edge 1040 partiva da 599,99), mentre per la serie Explore si parte dai 399,99 euro dell'Edge Explore 3 (l’Explore 2 costava 299,99 euro) per arrivare ai 499,99 euro per la versione Explore 3 Plus.

items.title: IKEA – 3D Guide
items.summary: Article URL: https://sael.net/flatpack/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50168096 Points: 94 # Comments: 23
items.content:
Manual © Inter IKEA Systems B.V. 2024 , shown unaltered with a link to the original. This piece is not made or endorsed by IKEA.

This is the BILLY bookcase, 80 × 28 × 202 cm , built from IKEA's own assembly manual (AA-1823127-9). The manual on the left is the real one, page for page. The 3D build follows it step by step: the same parts, the same hardware counts, in the same order, seen from roughly the angle each drawing uses.

Two sides, a top, a bottom, a fixed middle shelf, a plinth, four loose shelves and a back panel folded in three. And 82 pieces of hardware: 16 wooden dowels, 12 cam screws, 12 cam locks, 18 nails, 16 shelf pins, 2 wall brackets with 2 screws and 4 washers. The Hardware in count follows each one as it goes in. The cyan outline against the wall is where all of it ends up.

BILLY holds together with cam locks . A cam screw goes into the side panel and stands proud of it. When the board goes on, the screw's head drops into a round cup (the cam) set into the board's face. Turning the cam half a turn clockwise drags the head along a spiral ramp inside it and pulls the two panels tight. The dowels only line things up; the cams do the clamping. The back panel, nailed on, is what stops the case racking out of square.

Step through with the arrows or the timeline, or press play to watch one step. Open the manual to read it as a book beside the build, and click any drawing on a page to jump there. Drawing shows the 3D in the manual's own black line style. Click a part to have its name and number read out.

Switch the piece to LACK table (or press ⇧K ) for IKEA's simplest build: the LACK side table, 55 × 55 × 45 cm, from its own manual (AA-2606170-1). One drawing, four double-ended screws (115980) and four legs, all by hand. The manual stops once the legs are on; turning it over is left to you, and the 3D does it as a third step.

The parts, counts, order and hardware numbers are the manual's. The board sizes come from the bookcase's published 80 × 28 × 202 cm; panel thickness, hole positions and the shelf heights are read off the drawings, so they are close, not measured. The 3D runs much faster than real hands do, and the manual asks for two people wherever the whole case is lifted or turned.

Fix it to the wall. The manual's first warning is that a bookcase that tips over can kill; the brackets in step 12 are there for that. Wall screws and plugs are not included, because the right ones depend on your wall.

[ ] previous and next step · 0 – 9 jump to a step · space play · ⇧B the manual · ⇧V room or drawing · ⇧X exploded · C play the whole build · R reset the view · ⇧N labels · drag to orbit · right-drag to pan · scroll to zoom · W A S D to move, Q E to turn.

items.title: Bonus mamme 2026, al via le domande. Come presentarle: le cose da sapere
items.summary: L'Inps comunica l'apertura alle richieste per il beneficio
items.content:
Via libera alle domande per il bonus mamme per il 2026 : l'Inps comunica l'apertura alle richieste per il beneficio che consiste in un'integrazione al reddito pari a 60 euro mensili per ciascun mese o frazione di mese di vigenza del rapporto di lavoro o dell'attività di lavoro autonomo nel 2026, fino a un massimo di dodici mensilità e a un importo complessivo massimo di 720 euro.

Il servizio per la presentazione della domanda è disponibile sul sito istituzionale www.inps.it .

Bonus Mamme - La circolare INPS numero 106 del 16 ottobre 2026

Dopo l'autenticazione, utilizzando la propria identità digitale si accede al "Punto d'accesso alle prestazioni non pensionistiche" per la compilazione della richiesta. La domanda può essere presentata anche tramite il Contact Center Multicanale , contattando il numero verde 803.164, gratuito da rete fissa, o il numero 06 164.164 da rete mobile, a pagamento.

La domanda deve essere presentata entro il 31 dicembre 2026 . Nel caso in cui il requisito si perfezioni nel mese di dicembre 2026, la domanda potrà essere presentata entro il 31 gennaio 2027 .

Il beneficio non spetta indistintamente a tutte le lavoratrici. Per le madri con due figli è necessario che il più piccolo non abbia ancora compiuto dieci anni . Per quelle con almeno tre figli , invece, il limite di età del figlio più piccolo è fissato a 18 anni . È inoltre richiesto che il reddito annuo da lavoro, dipendente o autonomo, non superi 40.000 euro .

Le mensilità spettanti per il periodo dal 1° gennaio 2026 al 31 dicembre 2026 sono corrisposte in unica soluzione nel mese di dicembre 2026, contestualmente alla mensilità riferita al medesimo mese, qualora l'istruttoria sia definita in tempo utile.

L'avvio dell'istruttoria avviene sulla base della data di presentazione della domanda. Qualora l'istruttoria non possa essere conclusa in tempo utile per il pagamento nel mese di dicembre, le somme spettanti saranno corrisposte, all'esito della relativa definizione, a decorrere dal mese di gennaio 2027 .

items.content:
Hey HN, this is Andy from Respan (https://www.respan.ai). We are building an open-source Rust AI gateway. It is a decoupled gateway, so everything is a plugin, including different providers, protocols (MCP, voice), modalities (images, videos), and gateway features (fallbacks, PII redaction, smart routing).

Instead of packaging tons of providers and features into one gateway, Respan provides a small core and public interfaces that teams can use to assemble the AI infrastructure their application needs. That way, users can build their own features as additional plugins without having to change the gateway's core.

Here’s a video demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pVv2ibXiTXM

There are countless LLM gateways and most of them solve a common problem: calling different providers from a single endpoint. However, adding new features can become prohibitively difficult. So developers can end up building another gateway to solve a specific problem.

We've been building our gateway based on LiteLLM since 2024, and now it's providing services for thousands of orgs. Each org needs different API key settings, routes, and limits. To support that, we kept wrapping LiteLLM, adding more features to it, and at one stage, our wrapper code exceeded 100,000 lines.

This January, a routine LiteLLM upgrade caused intermittent connection errors, and we had to roll back. We still haven't figured out the cause, but since then, we no longer upgrade LiteLLM directly and instead manually backport upstream fixes. These experiences made us realize that continuing to patch LiteLLM is not a sustainable long-term solution, and we had to redesign the gateway ourselves.

While redesigning our gateway, we wanted to make it easier to add features without breaking existing ones. Inspired by Nginx, we think an AI gateway should have a really small core, only responsible for dispatching events.

We believe that everything should be a plugin in our gateway, including providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), protocols (chat, realtime voice, MCP), modalities (images, videos), and gateway features for reliability and security (smart routing, fallbacks, and PII redaction through example plugins). Beyond that, we want developers to be able to easily extend the gateway's capabilities by adding their own plugins, without touching the core. Adding a provider, even your own, is dead simple, because quirks are plugins too and there’s nothing magical about them. A provider is a short file, Mistral’s is 22 lines, and each quirk, like Groq putting token usage in its own field, gets its own test.

Respan Gateway does more than let you call Claude or Gemini models from the OpenAI SDK. It handles tools, images, and reasoning protocols automatically: an application based on the OpenAI Realtime API can also use Gemini Live through the gateway, though not every feature translates. A simple chat app can use MCP tools configured in the gateway, without implementing MCP itself.

We also parse requests into a shared structure. When the client and provider use the same API, we preserve provider-specific fields in their native format, even if our shared structure doesn't have a field for them. That way, the gateway can write them back instead of dropping them.

Here’s how it works:

An adapter hands each HTTP or WebSocket connection to the first client format that recognizes it. The format exposes the request as a two-way stream of typed input and output events. The core runs plugins in registration order, allowing them to choose a provider, filter or wrap either stream, make additional calls, return a response, or refuse the request. A provider format then opens the upstream connection.

If the client and provider use the same format and no plugin changes the payload, the original bytes and protocol-specific fields can pass through unchanged. When formats differ, they translate through shared types for messages, tool calls, results, streams, and usage. This stream model can represent both one-shot HTTP requests and long-lived bidirectional sessions.

The gateway is open source at https://github.com/respanai/respan-gateway under the MIT or Apache-2.0 license. You don't need to use Respan's hosted platform and can run it directly on your local machine. Build it from source, add your provider keys, and swap the base URL in a supported client. You can keep using the API your client already speaks. It's still pre-alpha.

We make money from our hosted platform (https://www.respan.ai/pricing), which runs the gateway for you with native observability and evals, along with unified billing.

If you’re building routing, tools, filtering, observability, or security for agents, we'd love to see it as a plugin. PLUGINS.md in the repo explains how to write one and links to the plugins we’ve created so far. Turning that into an ecosystem is basically our roadmap, and we welcome you to contribute your own plugins. We'd love to answer any questions and hear your feedback!

https://github.com/respanai/respan-gateway

items.title: Una foto con gli occhi chiusi? Lightroom su mobile li apre con un tocco, usando l’IA
items.summary: Su iPhone, iPad e Android debutta la funzione Open Eyes: se qualcuno ha battuto le palpebre al momento dello scatto, l’IA generativa ricostruisce gli occhi ... Leggi tutto
items.content:
Una foto riuscita, se non fosse per quella persona che ha chiuso gli occhi proprio al momento dello scatto. Adobe vuole risolvere uno degli inconvenienti più comuni della fotografia con Open Eyes, nuova funzione della versione mobile di Lightroom che utilizza l’Intelligenza Artificiale generativa per aprire gli occhi dei soggetti con un solo tocco.

La novità è disponibile nella versione di Lightroom per iOS, iPadOS e Android e non richiede una selezione manuale particolarmente elaborata.

Quando l’applicazione individua uno o più soggetti con gli occhi chiusi, propone automaticamente Open Eyes tra le azioni rapide, mostrando direttamente sulla fotografia l’icona dalla quale avviare la correzione. A quel punto è l’IA a generare il risultato, cercando di mantenere coerenti illuminazione, posizione del viso e caratteristiche della persona.

Ok, ma come fa Adobe a sapere come sono gli occhi di una persona se sono chiusi? Se nella libreria di Lightroom sono presenti altre immagini della stessa persona, Open Eyes può utilizzarle come riferimento per cercare di riprodurre più accuratamente colore, forma e dimensione degli occhi.

Altrimenti, di fatto, il sistema di Lightroom ricostruisce degli occhi credibili ma che molto probabilmente non corrisponderanno (per colore, per esempio) a quelli del soggetto della foto.

Photoshop Elements offre da anni una funzione simile, ma con un approccio differente: il software può prendere gli occhi da un'altra fotografia della stessa persona e utilizzarli per correggere lo scatto. Il risultato dipende quindi anche da quanto le due immagini siano compatibili per posizione del viso, luce ed espressione.

Anche Photoshop permette già di raggiungere risultati simili attraverso i suoi strumenti generativi, ma richiede un intervento più articolato. In Lightroom Adobe sta cercando di trasformare la stessa operazione in una funzione automatica accessibile direttamente dall'interfaccia mobile.

Open Eyes è una funzione gratuita, ma ci sono dei limiti sebbene Adobe non sia chiara in merito. Secondo quanto riportato da DPReview , gli utenti della versione gratuita possono provare Open Eyes due volte; al terzo tentativo viene proposta la sottoscrizione di un piano Adobe Creative Cloud che comprenda ulteriori crediti per le funzioni basate sull'IA.

items.title: Ofcom concedes defeat in 4chan case
items.summary: Article URL: https://prestonbyrne.com/2026/10/20/ofcom-concedes-defeat/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50167028 Points: 237 # Comments: 149
items.content:
Insofar as a political organization like Ofcom is even capable of admitting defeat, it did so in the 4chan enforcement today.

In testimony before the Commons Digital, Culture, Media, and Sport Committee, Ofcom admitted it knows its jurisdiction ends where a foreign court’s jurisdiction begins.

“If foreign courts decide to… try and get in our way, there will be a point at which we have to accept that we won’t be able to recover that money.”

Guido Fawkes characterizes this admission thus: “ Ofcom Admits Defeat .”

Guido is right. American courts have, by now, provided their preliminary view on the likelihood of Ofcom’s enforcement powers being successful in U.S. courts – the obiter dicta in 4chan v. Ofcom , the opinion in the case we filed against Ofcom in the federal District Court for the District of Columbia a little over a year ago.

Those dicta made it awfully clear that Ofcom can expect a very chilly reception in an American courtroom if it ever tries to enforce its fines in the United States. By way of reminder, the Court in 4chan said:

Because Plaintiffs represent that they have “no presence, infrastructure, or operations abroad,” Pls.’ Opp’n at 5; Compl. paras. 20, 24, that likely means enforcing any judgment in the United States. At that point, Plaintiffs could avail themselves of the protection of American courts.

Unless Ofcom is prepared to sail a British invasion fleet here and land ground troops, enforcement would indeed have to proceed through American courts. Which presents the following problem for Ofcom:

American courts generally decline to enforce foreign judgments that violate the United States Constitution , if indeed Plaintiffs are correct in their constitutional claims. See, e.g. , Matusevitch v. Telnikoff , 877 F. Supp. 1, 4 (D.D.C. 1995) (refusing to enforce a British judgment because it contravened the First Amendment and was therefore “repugnant to the public policies of the State of Maryland and the United States”)[.]

Suffice it to say, 4chan’s constitutional arguments are correct.

The Court then added, gratuitously and sua sponte as this was not an issue which was actually briefed by either party in the case,

Finally, at the risk of gilding the lily, to the extent any foreign judgment against Plaintiffs were penal in nature, Plaintiffs may find a receptive audience before American courts regardless of the judgment’s compatibility with the United States Constitution. That is because American courts are not necessarily required to enforce foreign penal judgments[.]

Ofcom can’t enforce the Online Safety Act in America. Ofcom knows it, Ofcom has known it for a long time, and now, Ofcom has, finally, admitted it. It would be a gift – to 4chan – if Ofcom decided to show up in an American court after all this.

Defeat, for all practical purposes, in one matter, however, will not stop Ofcom and British parliamentarians in their continuing mission to censor the British people, and the world.

What will happen next is that Ofcom is going to go back to Parliament to ask for the authority to obtain “interim business disruption measures” – i.e., more or less unilateral censorship powers to block foreign websites in the UK before starting an enforcement process, rather than after. These powers were explicitly rejected by Parliament the last time around and have even now been repudiated by Nadine Dorries, the former MP who introduced the Bill, having seen what a mess Ofcom has made of it. These powers will also be easily defeated through the use of a VPN.

They may also seek to block 4chan. My client has already priced that in and it is a price worth paying, as this will constitute the UK censoring its own people and ISPs, rather than censoring my client. The UK has the sovereign right to do that. My client has the constitutional right to decline to assist the UK in that terrible work.

The UK thus continues its authoritarian backsliding. Sorting out their own country is, ultimately, a matter for the British, and opposing the grant of new powers for Ofcom – an agency manifestly unable to wield power very well, seeing as they were foiled by a handful of American solos working for free – on domestic policy grounds is a task for the growing UK free speech movement to take up, with urgency.

I wish them luck in that important work. In the meantime, we Americans have plenty more work to do on this side of the pond to protect our border and prevent the British, Australian, Russian , and other foreign censorship regimes from crossing it.

Ofcom has targeted 200-ish American platforms with censorship orders; only four of those sites, all of which are my clients, refused, and only one is 4chan. The First Amendment remains very much under direct, sustained assault from foreign censorship agencies.

We have a long way to go until our fight with the foreign censors is done.

We need permanent U.S. law reform, like passing the GRANITE Act , to turn the tide.

items.title: My Friend Bob Cringely
items.summary: Article URL: https://tyma.com/my-cringe-story/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50166794 Points: 133 # Comments: 37
items.content:
In 1996, I was a Ph.D. student at Syracuse University. One evening I was sitting in my office and the phone rang,__ “Hello?” “Is this Paul Tyma?” “Yes?”

Bob replied in very fast English. “This is Bob Cringely. I just read 7 Java books and yours is the best.”

My first thought was “Huh. He actually said my last name correctly”.

But my quick 2nd thought was that there were not, in fact, 7 Java books in existence. I did indeed write a Java book, but to my knowledge, mine was the 2nd on the market and even then, I’m not sure it was the best. My Ph.D. advisor, Doug Lea, had been an early member of the Java project at Sun Microsystems. He introduced Java (and the JVM) to all his grad students and I believe something like 4 of us wrote books piggybacking upon the hype at the time.

In any case, as you might know, it is not common to get accolades or even much attention for writing a programming book 1 . I had no idea who this “Bob Cringely” person was, but, um, Thanks! So glad you liked it - let’s talk some more about how great it is!

I didn’t know it then, but Bob was way ahead of me. It’s likely he pictured me as some lonely computer geek (or “nerd” in his parlance) sitting in a tiny office tip-tapping away at some code enjoying yesterday’s pizza. (He was right). He also knew computer nerds like me were typically a bit starved for attention, especially around anything related to computer-centric achievements. Again, Bob knew his audience.

Writing a programming book in the 1990’s afforded many of the same benefits as today. In other words, nearly nothing. You sure weren’t getting rich off writing books. But it did get me invites to teach Java at some Software Conferences. Which then got me invites to train Java to teams inside different companies. Because of that, my friend and I started a company around Java training. We hadn’t done any contract programming until then, but we’d talked about it plenty.

From there, Bob hired us to build him a system called (or codenamed?) “Pronto”.

Pronto was to be the distribution future of print Magazines. The big idea was for customers (who were paper magazine subscribers) to install a small daemon process on their computer that would monitor for times where their Internet connection (i.e. often dialup modem at this point) was online but mostly idle. Our system would then slowly but persistently download their next month’s issue of “Good Housekeeping” or “Car and Driver””. Once it was fully downloaded, the daemon would lie in wait until 2am the next morning and send the PDF off to their home printer. The customer would wake up to be happily surprised by a fully printed copy of their magazine waiting for them! 2

Like many at the time, Bob didn’t believe that reading online would replace reading a full-color, paper magazine. But how that magazine got to your house could change, and that’s where Pronto came in.

Bob had secured funding for Pronto - from someone in Japan I think. I don’t remember, but I remember Bob paid us consistently for the time it took to develop Pronto. After we finished, I don’t know what happened to Pronto, except that it never released in any meaningful sense. But this did begin my 30-year relationship with Bob (or “Cringe” as we called him).

As I said, before this, I had no idea who Bob was. I didn’t know about his claim-to-fame book “Accidental Empires”. His PBS series “Triumph of the Nerds” was released right around the time I was working with/for him. Well after Pronto somehow I got put on Bob’s list of “People I’m going to send my next startup idea to for thoughts” email list. I was by no means alone on that list, and sometimes I got into email threads with some interesting Tech personalities.

I just took a look - and I have had 320 emails with Bob in the past 13 years. Mind you, those aren’t unique emails, most are part of long email chains so I’d estimate I’d email with Bob about 3 times a year since the late 90’s.

Usually, the email chains started with Bob emailing me a wall-of-text about his new startup idea. While the first half of the email was about the idea, invariably, the 2nd half was about how much money it was going to make. I was always impressed at how “to the penny” he got with his projections for something that was basically an idea written on a virtual napkin.

Some ideas were good, and some were not so good. Through my career, I actually joined him in 2 ventures - home-account and Sonisafe. I have the pitch decks for a few, and the detailed descriptions of a bunch more ideas that maybe no one else has seen. This was a great honor in the beginning, especially as his fame grew. But all along the way, I felt Bob was missing the point.

If you ever met Bob - or heck, just saw him in any of his TV specials, you could see Bob charmed everyone he met. He was good-looking, disarming, and curious. He was also an excellent writer, but it was on the screen he really shined. He was comforting and fun to watch. He was fearless and made people feel special. He wasn’t a “nerd” but if, like me, you were; he understood you and he made it OK. In fact, at times, he even made it look glamorous.

Despite his innumerable gifts, Bob seemed to really want to be a superstar startup founder. I’m sure if one of his startup ideas had exploded, Bob would have filled the role fine. But to me - he was a pure natural in front of the camera. I always thought he should start a Youtube channel interviewing Silicon Valley celebrities. I sent him a few emails along those lines, but Bob would mostly just ignore me. He was usually too excited about his new/current startup idea.

When I lived in San Francisco, he and I had lunch or dinner occasionally. He really was a Silicon Valley celebrity. When the inevitable person(s) would come up to him telling them they were a huge fan, he’d act like it the first time anyone ever recognized him. Every time. The TV Cringe instantly came to life and it was always a pleasure to watch.

Goodbye Mr. Cringely. I’m very sorry to see you go. I will miss you.

Right after the C# language was released (it must have been around 2001 or so?), I spent the evening and into the morning reading about it. Finally around 2am, with bleary eyes and a racing mind I emailed Bob - “Dotnet is going to squish Java”.

I spent the next hour writing an overly long and terribly rough email, in a half-awake, caffeine-induced state and sent it off. I woke up the next morning to Bob’s new blog post - a rather lightly edited version of my rant!

Sharper Than Ever. Microsoft’s C# Language Might Be the Death of Java, but Sun’s the One to Blame

I just remember being grateful he didn’t mention me. But then, he called me later that day, “Sun is a bit unhappy with the blog post. I’ve been summoned to Sun Headquarters tomorrow and you’re coming with me.”

The next day Bob and I went to Sun Microsystems. He and I sat in a room with Jonathan Schwartz (CEO) and Rich Greene (C-something-else) while they defended Java and gave me nasty looks wondering who the hell I was and why the hell I was even there. They seemed plenty interested in impressing Bob though. By the way, Dotnet didn’t squish Java but I did get a Sun t-shirt.

After that, Whenever I emailed him, I often tacked onto the bottom of my emails - “Do whatever you want with this email, but don’t mention me. And know this email could be totally wrong or silly - either way, it’s yours now”.

In and around 2004 I was living in NYC and I got a forwarded email from Bob. It was a forward from a Producer at the TV network VH1 telling him they were doing a video series called “My Coolest Years” and had a special episode about “Geeks” and they needed a computer geek. They asked him if he wanted to be interviewed about what it was like being a “geek” in high school.

“Sorry, but I got laid plenty in high school. However, I have cc’d my friend Paul who actually was a geek in high school. He also lives in NYC.”

I ended up with a total of about 8 minutes in the show alongside Mark Cuban, John Tesh, Ben Stein, and Wil Wheaton. Bob would have been way better.

Randomly, a few months ago I once again watched Bob’s “Plane Crazy.” A classic. And because of the comments surrounding his death I found that his special “The Transformation Age” is also on Youtube which I had never seen (in 8 or so separate videos). It’s quintessential Cringe.

[Bob’s The Transformation Age] (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FuUcOF0WdQ)

I once did a Book Signing at the SD West conference; I believe in 1998. Mind you, I did a “Book Signing”, not to be confused with a “Books Signing”. I signed one book. I bet that copy is worth something. ↩

We always seemed to ignore the challenges around the idea of having 100 loose-leaf, one-sided pieces of paper that were this month’s issue of their favorite magazine. ↩

items.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 73 security recruits, local authorities say
items.summary: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province on Monday that was being used as a training centre, Yemen's army says.
items.content:
More than 70 security personnel were killed in a Houthi missile strike on a camp in Yemen's central province of Shabwa on Monday, local authorities say.

The Saudi-backed Yemeni armed forces said the Iran-backed group launched three ballistic missiles at al-Alam camp near Ataq city, which was being used as a training centre for recruits to the security forces and police.

The head of Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council, Rashad al-Alimi, condemned what he called the "criminal attack" and promised a "firm response".

The Houthis' military spokesman said they had targeted "Saudi enemy concentrations".

Yemen's devastating civil war has flared up in recent months.

At the start of October, pro-government forces launched a major offensive that aims to retake territory in western Yemen that is controlled by the Houthis.

With air support from a Saudi-led coalition of Arab states, they managed to regain control of territory on the Red Sea coast that overlooks the strategically important Bab al-Mandab Strait, which the Houthis captured in a surprise assault in September.

However, fierce fighting is continuing there, as well as around the besieged government-controlled city of Taiz, and to the north in Marib and al-Jawf provinces.

The Houthis have also responded to the Saudi air strikes by launching missiles and drones at airports, energy facilities and military bases in neighbouring Saudi Arabia.

Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says

On Yemen's desert battlefield, a war with global consequences is being waged

'We are terrified but we want to get an education', say Yemeni schoolgirls

Monday's attack in Shabwa was the deadliest reported since the start of the escalation.

Shabwa province's media office said in a statement that ballistic missiles struck the Martyr Ahmed al-Sulaimani Training Centre, where recruits from several provinces were undergoing training to be members of the internal security forces.

A video posted on social media appeared to show several bodies scattered across the ground at the camp.

Hospitals in the province were overwhelmed and were forced to transfer the most seriously wounded people to neighbouring Hadramout and Aden, where the government is based, Shabwa's deputy governor, Fahad al-Khalifi, told AFP news agency.

Shabwa's media office initially reported that 53 people were killed and 200 injured in the attack.

But on Tuesday, it said in a new statement that Governor Awad bin al-Wazir had been informed by an investigative committee that the death toll was now 73, with another 14 individuals reported missing.

Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani said the attack constituted a war crime because the internal security forces training centre was not a military target.

He also accused the Houthis of "attempting to fabricate a false media victory, boost the morale of its collapsing elements, and cover up the defeats and setbacks it is suffering across various combat axes".

The Houthis' military spokesman, Yahya Sarea, said in a statement that the missiles targeted a gathering of "Saudi enemy" forces at al-Alam camp, which he said was run by Saudi officers.

In a separate development, Houthi-run media reported that a Saudi air strike on a home in the Sahar district of the Houthi-controlled northern province of Saada on Sunday killed at least 10 people and injured 23 others, many of them women and children.

According to the Houthi-run health ministry in north-western Yemen, a total of 141 people had been killed in Saudi strikes over the past seven weeks.

The government's health ministry, meanwhile, said last week that at least 1,282 people had been killed in the conflict across Yemen since 6 August.

In Saudi Arabia, at least 19 people have been killed in Houthi attacks targeting the kingdom's airports since the beginning of October.

Yemen has been devastated by a civil war that began in 2014, when the Houthis ousted the government from the capital, Sanaa. The conflict escalated in 2015, after the Saudi-led coalition intervened in an attempt to restore the government's rule.

A four-year-old informal ceasefire began to unravel in July, when the Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea.

The Houthis said they were retaliating for what they call a Saudi blockade of their territory, as well as an air strike on Sanaa airport that they blamed on the kingdom.

items.title: EMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items.summary: Article URL: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50166579 Points: 413 # Comments: 223
items.content:
The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. They chain to roots trusted by the Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome root programs and by many downstream trust stores.

To demonstrate that the keys are compromised, the original reporter Wayne signed the following message with the private key of each of the eight intermediate CAs and reported it to the Root Program Teams on the 17th of October:

proof.zip contains the message, and for each intermediate the certificate, its public key and a signature on the message. To verify with OpenSSL:

The root programs and many downstream trust stores have taken action to protect their users. The certificates have been blocked in Firefox and Chrome since the 17th of October and in Apple devices since the 19th.

The issue was responsibly disclosed to downstream trust stores on the 19th of October. Many have already released updates or are in the process of releasing updates.

An attacker with the private key of any of the compromised intermediate CAs could impersonate any website or service.

This has already been remediated by Mozilla, Apple and Chrome for their users through their tools for distributing revocation information such as OneCRL , CRLite and CRLSets .

The CA has also revoked the compromised intermediate certificates. However, many other clients do not consume revocation information and require software updates to ensure they no longer trust the compromised intermediates.

A certificate error means the client does not trust the compromised intermediates.

To check a trust store offline, chains.zip contains the certificate chain served by each of the twelve hosts above in PEM format, with instructions for verifying them with OpenSSL.

Users should update their browsers and operating systems to the latest versions as soon as possible.

macOS blocks the compromised intermediates, but the built-in /usr/bin/curl verifies certificates against /etc/ssl/cert.pem without checking revocation, and that file has not been updated. To remove the affected roots from it, run:

Until a distribution ships an updated ca-certificates package, expert users can distrust the affected roots in the system trust store. This is NOT recommended for ordinary users.

On Fedora, RHEL, CentOS Stream, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux and Amazon Linux 2023, run as root:

Please see this thread in Mozilla's dev-security-policy forum.

impacted-intermediates.json lists the eight intermediates and their Sectigo cross-signs. roots.json lists the roots they chain to.
